explanation.en: Frequency counts cycles per second. Period T = 1/f. Peak amplitude and peak-to-peak amplitude are different measurements. CRO settings change the display, not the source.
explanation.or: Frequency ହେଉଛି ପ୍ରତି second ରେ cycle ସଂଖ୍ୟା। T = 1/f। Peak ଓ peak-to-peak amplitude ଅଲଗା। CRO setting source signal ବଦଳାଏ ନାହିଁ।

questions.prompt: What is the unit of frequency?
questions.explanation: Frequency is measured in Hz.

questions.prompt: What is the period of a 1 kHz signal?
A centred sine has 1 V peak. What is its peak-to-peak amplitude?
questions.explanation: Peak-to-peak spans the positive and negative peaks.

questions.prompt: Changing CRO time/div changes what?
questions.explanation: The display scale changes; the source remains the same.

questions.prompt: Which signal has more cycles per second?
questions.explanation: 82.5 kHz is greater than 1 kHz.

explanation.en: The message carries the information. The carrier supplies a higher-frequency reference for modulation. Trace each source to its designated input.
explanation.or: Message ରେ ସୂଚନା ଥାଏ। Carrier ର frequency ଅଧିକ। ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ source କୁ ଠିକ input ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ।

questions.prompt: Which signal represents the information?
questions.explanation: The message is the information-bearing signal.

questions.prompt: Where should the AF output go?
questions.explanation: AF supplies the low-frequency message.

questions.prompt: Which source supplies the carrier in this pack?
questions.explanation: The manual specifies an 82.5 kHz RF source.

questions.prompt: What does a patch cord do here?
questions.explanation: Patch cords establish the signal path.

questions.prompt: Removing the message should remove which ideal output?
questions.explanation: Without a message, the ideal balanced product is zero.

explanation.en: A balanced modulator multiplies message and carrier. For sinusoidal inputs the product has sidebands at fc - fm and fc + fm. Null adjustment reduces carrier leakage; a time trace alone does not prove complete suppression.
explanation.or: Balanced modulator message ଓ carrier କୁ multiply କରେ। Sideband frequency ହେଉଛି fc - fm ଓ fc + fm। Null adjustment carrier leakage କମାଏ।

questions.prompt: What does SC stand for?
questions.explanation: SC denotes suppressed carrier.

questions.prompt: Which operation models ideal DSB-SC generation?
questions.explanation: Multiplication shifts the message to sidebands.

questions.prompt: For fc = 82.5 kHz and fm = 1 kHz, where are the sidebands?
questions.explanation: Subtract and add the message frequency to the carrier frequency.

questions.prompt: What is null adjustment used for?
questions.explanation: Balancing reduces the residual carrier term.

questions.prompt: Does an attractive CRO trace prove zero carrier leakage?

options.b: No; appropriate spectral or other validated evidence is needed

questions.explanation: A time trace alone does not establish complete carrier suppression.

explanation.en: A synchronous detector multiplies DSB-SC by a coherent reference. Low-pass filtering retains the message term. With unit carrier amplitudes and unity recovery gain, the ideal output peak is half the input message peak.
explanation.or: Synchronous detector ପାଇଁ coherent reference ଦରକାର। Low-pass filter message ଅଂଶ ରଖେ। ଏହି ideal model ରେ output peak, message peak ର ଅଧା।

questions.prompt: What extra input does synchronous detection need?
questions.explanation: The receiver needs a coherent reference.

questions.prompt: Which section removes the high-frequency product?
questions.explanation: Low-pass filtering retains baseband.

questions.prompt: Which receiver output frequency is expected here?
questions.explanation: Recovery returns the message frequency.

questions.prompt: Can a simple envelope detector generally recover DSB-SC correctly?

options.b: No; coherent detection is required in this experiment

questions.explanation: DSB-SC lacks the conventional AM carrier-supported envelope.

questions.prompt: For a 1 V peak message in this ideal unity-gain receiver, what is the recovered peak?
questions.explanation: Multiplication gives a half-amplitude baseband term before gain correction.

explanation.en: Follow the instructor-approved supply and common-reference procedure. Stabilise the display before reading frequency and amplitude, retain units, and compare recovered frequency with message frequency. Virtual readings do not count as physical observations.
explanation.or: ଶିକ୍ଷକଙ୍କ supply ଓ connection ନିୟମ ମାନନ୍ତୁ। ସ୍ଥିର display ରୁ frequency ଓ amplitude ପଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ। Virtual reading ପ୍ରକୃତ lab observation ନୁହେଁ।

questions.prompt: Who approves physical power-on checks?
questions.explanation: Physical power-on checks belong to the instructor-approved procedure.

questions.prompt: Which values should be compared after detection?
questions.explanation: The recovered frequency should match the message frequency.

questions.prompt: A moving display should first prompt what check?
questions.explanation: Check display stability and signal routing.

questions.prompt: How should amplitude be recorded?

options.c: With units and peak or peak-to-peak convention

questions.explanation: State both units and amplitude convention.

questions.prompt: What does finishing this preparation establish?
questions.explanation: Physical execution remains a separate instructor-observed activity.
